text:
maria: Heads up from ACME SI: marketplace reviewer requested sanitized artifacts for listing. Need pen-test PDF, vuln CSV (sanitized), SOC2 summary, and vendor HSM attestation. Deadline: Thu EOD. Who can own redaction + upload?

derek: I can do redaction. Plan: pull into staging, run automated scripts, then manual review. Will remove emails, IPs, stack traces, and replace internal hostnames.

sam: For HSM attestation, vendor sent vendor_hsm.asc; ops needs to decrypt and checksum before we include it. I'll request S3 staging write role now.

jessica: I will upload sanitized bundle to s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence/acme-si/ and create presigned URLs for reviewers. Prefer 7-day presign unless reviewers ask longer. Example: aws s3 presign ... --expires-in 604800

marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace evidence retention is 90 days and presigned access should be logged.

derek: Redaction snippets I'll use: sed to redact emails and IPs, perl to mask UUIDs. For vuln CSV, only include (CVE,severity,status,remediation-summary). No customer or hostname fields.

sam: Decrypt command (GPG): gpg --output vendor_hsm.tar --decrypt vendor_hsm.asc ; then sha256sum vendor_hsm.tar > vendor_hsm.sha256. Upload both to staging.

maria: Owners: @derek redaction, @sam decrypt + checksum, @jessica upload/presign. Schedule: Derek done by Wed 10:00, Sam by Wed 14:00, Jessica upload by Wed 18:00. Escalate to @lina-sales if blocked.

jessica: Will need reviewer emails to lock presign access if marketplace supports allowlist. Please DM me the list. I'll post links here when ready. :white_check_mark:
